title: 电商份额止跌：外卖亏损砍七成，阿里甜蜜点还能持续多久？
speaker: Jiong Shao

segments.en: Adivabas has been, it has kind of a slow growing legacy e-commerce business. They've been losing market share for years.
segments.zh: 阿里一直有增长缓慢的传统电商业务，多年来市场份额持续流失。

segments.en: The reason we think that in a sweet spot is that the e-commerce business is no longer losing share. Then more or less growing line with the industry.
segments.zh: 我们认为处于甜蜜点的原因是电商业务不再丢失份额，基本与行业同步增长。

segments.en: And the profit margin has stable as well.
And on top of that, the losses for the food delivery business is coming down very, very fast. It was 36 billion, some crazy number of backing September quarter last year. Now it's 10 billion.
segments.zh: 此外，外卖业务的亏损正在快速收窄，从去年9月当季的360亿降至现在的100亿。

segments.en: So they cut the loss by 70-75% for the food delivery business.
segments.zh: 外卖业务亏损削减了70%到75%。

segments.en: So the sweet spot put them where the growing AI business very, very fast, but the core business is doing okay.
segments.zh: 所以甜蜜点在于AI业务高速增长，而核心业务表现稳健。
